root_cause_review.statistics: SetMinMaxPair copies a floating-point local while its scope is still active. Copy stores the scalar, not its address. The compiler access-pass dump has end-of-scope clobbers only on exit blocks with no path back to the use. The same preprocessed translation unit compiles without warnings under host GCC 16.2.1.
root_cause_review.subtree: The warning is in the unchanged Forest.HourlyETL upstream test, on destruction of a temporary std::vector<std::string> created from two live strings for a join call. There is no application pointer adjustment or manual delete. Both GCC 15 and 16 report the diagnostic for this preprocessed source. The actual warning-producing object links and passes all six Forest/Subtree tests under Valgrind.
